scope.mode: Read-only offline engineering trace audit of all64 captured frozen attempts
scope.raw_export: No source/tool bodies, generated code, artifact base64, secret/environment values, signed links or workspace paths exported. Per-job metadata and engineering classifications only.

representative_findings.finding: Primary numeric and CSV/figure contract pass with actual same-conversation R review. Frozen source conjunction fails: official function document was read before broader search, whose hits omit that exact function-document URL. This is a source-workflow requirement failure, not unavailable retrieval.

Planner exhausts three-call phase without a design. Two execute_r requests are unavailable at planning stage; no actual R or reviewer occurs. Counting this as wrong numerical inference would confuse missing output with a tested formula.

Completed primary numerical agreement. One continuous-event row differs from executed JSON by9.95e-14, accepted under runtime relative1e-9 but rejected by scorer exact equality. Delivered sensitivity_plot.png is also ignored by unrequested basename gate.

Blind reviewer e4 executes before candidate reveal, detects double scaling of standardized delta/raw SD. Initial candidate n9340 is replaced by actual repair e6 n84; second blind precheck e7 and comparison e8 execute in round1. Rereview has only two remaining model calls and cannot submit an accepted review; original run remains budget_exhausted. Actual benefit and terminal deficit both present.
Solver exhausts6 calls/3R before candidate/reviewer. Retained outputs do not justify independent review or end-to-end success.

Completed oracle-compatible primary outputs with successful blind reviewer e4 before reveal and post-reveal e5. Method identifier differs from frozen canonical design string. Source search chain and image basename gates also fail; this is not a full strict success.

Completed primary/CSV/figure contract agreement with actual self-review. Review IDs include a successful nonJSON reviewer/check execution in addition to a valid numerical reviewer; runtime permits that combination but frozen scorer rejects all-ID computed-object requirement.

Candidate event formula is materially wrong under frozen oracle. Shared-context review requests revision and identifies inconsistency with source examples, but no actual reviewer R call occurs in that phase; review cites coder debug failures rather than independent check. Actual repair R fails syntax and cannot yield a valid current-round replacement.

Candidate primary treatment variance/MDE disagree with frozen oracle. Required self-review begins but exhausts5calls/2R before accepted review. Data errors and type/grounding failures cannot be treated as merely plotting filename effects.

Completed correct primary values, actual blind e5 before reveal, sensitivity recomputation e6 and artifact inspection e7. The only frozen source conjunction pass. Figure sensitivity_plot.png is actually delivered but excluded by image basename gate; a successful nonJSON reviewer e6 is included beside valid JSON reviewers, producing a separate scorer/runtime ID mismatch. Visual content is not certified by header inspection.

Real candidate CSV/plot and JSON exist, but blind reviewer attempts remain computednull, including a nonfinite calculation and later formatting/operator failure. Candidate is never revealed; no accepted review. This establishes invocation, not a completed independent numerical precheck.

Accepted candidate disagrees numerically with frozen oracle. Coder file-output path errors and reviewer permission errors occur; later blind executions still omit usable results JSON. Review submission is rejected before candidate reveal and phase exhausts. No scientific validation claim follows from file production.

measurement_contract_limits.proof: All8 dispatched query texts request actual PNG/PDF sensitivity plot, explicitly name sensitivity.csv, and contain neither sensitivity.png nor sensitivity.pdf. common payload has only verification/budget/search options; dispatch.make_request uses exact task query. Frozen scorer.check_artifacts accepts only sensitivity.png/pdf.
measurement_contract_limits.effect: Delivered real sensitivity_plot.png may be recorded missing_sensitivity_figure. Keep primary original scores; separately quantify delivery without this unrequested name gate. Figure correctness still requires visual rubric.

measurement_contract_limits.proof: Runtime validates exact metric/unit and numeric delta<=1e-9*max(1,abs(computed)); scorer.check_execution uses all-three exact equality. One completed continuous-event row differs9.95e-14.
measurement_contract_limits.effect: Representation-level linkage failure is not an observed scientific numeric error. No numeric/unit/name conversion proposed or applied.

measurement_contract_limits.proof: Runtime accepts additional successful current-round reviewer IDs for nonJSON/file checks provided actual JSON numerical reviewer evidence exists; frozen scorer filters every review ID to computed-object execution.
measurement_contract_limits.effect: Eight completed pass-review records across conditions are penalized for successful nonJSON check IDs alongside real numerical checks. Actual missing/stale/wrong-role IDs and absent numerical checks remain genuine failures.

measurement_contract_limits.proof: Frozen source contract requires named-document search hit before read and linked final citation. Successful direct read/cite alone does not pass; broad relevant search may fail named-URL match.
measurement_contract_limits.effect: A low conjunction score is not provider unavailability or absence of any primary-document read. Preserve criterion and qualify its interpretation.

observed_multi_benefits: Ten multi runs reveal candidates only after actual successful current-round blind JSON R prechecks; serial blinded handoff is real, not labels alone.

One shared-budget paired case detects a severe parameterization error before comparison, performs actual coder repair and a second blind precheck; revised primary matches frozen oracle despite terminal rereview failure.
Expanded multi has7/12 primary numerical matches and5/12 completed numerical matches versus4/12 and3/12 in expanded single; this is a selected-task descriptive difference.
observed_multi_deficits: Shared multi has4/12 primary matches and2/12 completed numerical matches versus6/12 and5/12 shared single.
Strict pass remains4/16 in every condition, entirely appropriate clarification; no calculation meets original composite criteria. Some measurement contracts are narrower than task/runtime contracts.
Complex Cox/stepped-wedge attempts still suffer actual math errors, absent numerical JSON, path/package/syntax failures or no valid precheck/review.
Reviewer reservations and fresh contexts do not guarantee enough calls for completed repair/rereview or scientific/visual correctness.
limits: Two repeats of8selected tasks, six source-family labels; no general population capability or superiority claim.
Identical operation profiles are not equal actual cost, token use or information history; source caches and repeated-source reading differ.
Main jobs are fresh CLI requests with no prior chat history in request payload. Browser follow-up history contamination is a separate unproven causal hypothesis.
All reviewer branches share Haiku and many checks share R/package formulas; fresh context is not independent scientific error generation.
NonJSON success may be legitimate file/check evidence; it cannot replace required numerical JSON grounding.
No scientific figure certification from this audit; original file/data checks and separately frozen visual rubric remain distinct.

No reruns, hidden answers, runtime changes or retroactive replacement of original strict scoring. Posthoc contract sensitivity must be labeled exploratory and retain genuine mathematical/grounding failures.
